Topic 2.3: Bible Story;

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Bible Story;. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: why they should be obedient result of Jonah’s b) explain results of Jonah’s to God and others disobedience?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Bible Story; means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Bible Story; from Kenya
3. practise Bible Story; in clear steps
4. apply Bible Story; in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BIBLE STORY;
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Bible Story; helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BIBLE STORY;
Study Bible Story; like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Bible Story; means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Bible Story; means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Bible Story; means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Bible Story;” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Bible Story; means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Bible Story; from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Bible Story; from Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Bible Story; from Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Bible Story; in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Bible Story; from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Bible Story; in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Bible Story; in clear steps. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Bible Story; in clear steps.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Bible Story; in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Bible Story; in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Bible Story; in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Bible Story; in one real-life situation this week.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Bible Story;” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Bible Story; in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Bible Story; is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Bible Story;” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Bible Story; means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Bible Story; in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Bible Story; from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Bible Story; in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Bible Story;” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Bible Story; in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Bible Story; to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Bible Story; means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Bible Story; from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Bible Story; in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Bible Story; from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Bible Story;: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Bible Story;?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. why they should be obedient result of Jonah’s b) explain results of Jonah’s to God and others disobedience?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Bible Story; means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Bible Story; means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Bible Story; from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
